Jonathan Kuminga on what excites him the most about sharing the court with LaMelo Ball:

"His ability of passing the ball. I've played with so many point guards in my career but I've never played with somebody that can pass as good as LaMelo"

So Steph and CP3 don't exist then??

items.title: I have a Barry Melrose memory that doubles as one of the most cherished experiences of my sports writing career.
items.author: Chad Finn
items.body_excerpt:
I have a Barry Melrose memory that doubles as one of the most cherished experiences of my sports writing career. 

You'll recall that when the Bruins won Game 7 in 2011 to win the Stanley Cup in Vancouver, there was rioting in the city. Media folks were told not to leave the arena.
